rationale: The agent executed a write action (return_delivered_order_items) without first confirming with the user, violating the confirm-before-write requirement. They also did not clearly confirm which “recently delivered order” or which non-tablet items to return, despite querying multiple orders. Crucially, the user asked how much they would get back, and the agent provided no refund amount or final information—only a closing pleasantry. While basic identification was attempted (name/zip lookup), the key policy requirements—confirmation before changes and providing correct final info—were not met. Therefore, the request was not completed in line with policy.
